title: Finite Field Grothendieck Inequality, Finite Field Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening and Finite Field Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Problems
content: We ask for finite field versions of following three: (1) Grothendieck Inequality, (2) Johnson-Lindenstrauss Flattening Lemma, (3) Bourgain-Tzafriri Restricted Invertibility Theorem.
